name: Menu
description: Dropdown menu with items, groups, and dividers. Renders a list of actionable items that can include icons, disabled states, and visual dividers for grouping related actions.

notes: Renders with role='menu' and items with role='menuitem'.
Disabled items are marked with aria-disabled='true' and are not focusable.
Divider items are rendered as separators with role='separator'.
All menu items are keyboard navigable with visible focus indicators.

items.description: Array of menu items to render. Items with divider=true render as visual separators.

onItemSelect.description: Callback fired when a non-disabled menu item is selected.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use Menu for contextual actions triggered by a button or right-click.
Group related items using dividers for visual clarity.
Provide aria-label on the root element to describe the menu purpose.
dont: Do not use Menu for primary navigation — use AppNavBar or SideNavigation instead.
Do not nest Menu components inside each other.
Do not render a menu without a triggering mechanism.
